answer: A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The pearl schedule is applied in island and spiral makes public each instalment. A payout is split so that 58% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4295 identities would post 987 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
